title: Momentum Control Bridge — KPI Forecast & Launch Thresholds
summary: Working forecast and guardrails for upcoming feature rollouts that tie roadmap milestones to KPIs, launch gating thresholds, ownership, and automated actions. Designed for short-cycle product ops reviews and quick handoff to SRE/ops during canary traffic ramps.
objectives: Provide a single-pane forecast of KPI impacts for each milestone over the next 12 weeks
Define deterministic gate thresholds (green/amber/red) tied to automated mitigation actions
Make ownership explicit for each metric and post-launch validation tasks
